messages:
Priya: Heads-up: promotion blocked; staging-e2e failing for auth-service. Tests showing 401 on refresh endpoint since 09:22 UTC.

Ethan: Can you paste the failing lines?

Priya: FAIL tests/e2e/test_refresh.py::test_refresh_cycle - expected 200 got 401. Resp headers include x-cache-status: HIT, x-cache-ttl: -1.

Nina: -1 TTL means CI fixture cache returned a stale fixture after the token-format change.

Priya: Reran with fixtures disabled (CI_FIXTURE_CACHE=0) -> green. So cache is the culprit.

Ethan: Fast path for release: pin to last-good image sha256:1122aabb and manual promote, then evict fixtures and re-run canary. Approve?

Nina: Approve. I'll run eviction after the pin: `ci/tools/invalidate --svc=auth-service --env=staging` (~2m). Also creating follow-up RD ticket to fix TTL handling.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused by failing checks: staging-e2e (job 6812345701). Manual promote approved by Ethan.

Ethan: Running `deploybot promote --image=sha256:1122aabb --env=staging --manual` now.

ci-bot: Manual promote initiated; canary redeployed to sha256:1122aabb (job 6812345701).

Nina: Eviction complete. Retrying job -> canary passed, staging e2e green.

Priya: Created RD-8044 for fixture cache TTL regression; assigned to Platform, P1 post-release. Added logs and x-cache-ttl evidence.

Ethan: Added release note: "auth-service pinned to last-known-good image due to CI fixture cache TTL regression; unpin after maintenance (RD-8044)."

deploy-bot: Promotion completed. Release window unblocked. :tada:
